######## DE/recent-fault/repair/not-contacted
{"verdict":"seller-must-prove","claimable":true,"used":false,"extended":false,"legalUntil":"2028-03-01","presumptionUntil":"2027-03-01","faultDate":"2026-10-01","rule":"Germany","replyDeadline":"2026-11-09","followupDeadline":"2026-11-02","summary":{"country":"DE","category":"phone","condition":"new","remedy":"repair","seller_response":"not-contacted","verdict":"seller-must-prove"}}
-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 March 2026. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

######## DE/old-purchase/refund/not-contacted
{"verdict":"expired","claimable":false,"used":false,"extended":false,"legalUntil":"2025-01-10","presumptionUntil":"2024-01-10","faultDate":"2026-10-01","rule":"Germany","replyDeadline":"2026-11-09","followupDeadline":"2026-11-02","summary":{"country":"DE","category":"phone","condition":"new","remedy":"refund","seller_response":"not-contacted","verdict":"expired"}}
-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 10 January 2023 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.

I request that you repair or replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge. If you cannot do this within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, I will ask to end the contract and receive a full refund.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 10 January 2023. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair or replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge. If you cannot do this within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, I will ask to end the contract and receive a full refund.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

######## DE/used-second-year/repair/no-reply
{"verdict":"covered","claimable":true,"used":true,"extended":false,"legalUntil":"2027-06-01","presumptionUntil":"2026-06-01","faultDate":"2026-09-01","rule":"Germany","replyDeadline":"2026-11-09","followupDeadline":"2026-11-02","summary":{"country":"DE","category":"phone","condition":"used","remedy":"repair","seller_response":"no-reply","verdict":"covered"}}
-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 June 2025 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 September 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 June 2025. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 June 2024 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. The goods were repaired under the legal guarantee on 15 August 2026, which extends your liability by 12 months under Directive (EU) 2024/1799.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 June 2024 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.

Because you have not repaired or replaced the goods within a reasonable time, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

Because you have not repaired or replaced the goods within a reasonable time, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 June 2024. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

Because you have not repaired or replaced the goods within a reasonable time, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 January 2027 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

- Photos or video of the fault

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 January 2027. Since then, you have refused to resolve the problem.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). It has the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you repair or replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge. If you cannot do this within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, I will ask to end the contract and receive a full refund.

Please confirm in writing by 15 October 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- email: followup

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair or replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge. If you cannot do this within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, I will ask to end the contract and receive a full refund.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you repair the [Product] free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation), articles L217-3 to L217-20, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within 2 years of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting a consumer mediator (médiateur de la consommation).

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

######## FR/repair-extended/replace/refused
{"verdict":"covered","claimable":true,"used":false,"extended":true,"legalUntil":"2027-06-01","presumptionUntil":"2026-06-01","faultDate":"2026-10-01","rule":"France","replyDeadline":"2026-11-09","followupDeadline":"2026-11-02","summary":{"country":"FR","category":"phone","condition":"new","remedy":"replace","seller_response":"refused","verdict":"covered"}}
-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 June 2024 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation), articles L217-3 to L217-20, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. The goods were repaired under the legal guarantee on 15 August 2026, which extends your liability by 12 months under Directive (EU) 2024/1799.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting a consumer mediator (médiateur de la consommation).

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 June 2024. Since then, you have refused to resolve the problem.

Under French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation), articles L217-3 to L217-20, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. The goods were repaired under the legal guarantee on 15 August 2026, which extends your liability by 12 months under Directive (EU) 2024/1799.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to a consumer mediator (médiateur de la consommation) and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 June 2024 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation), articles L217-3 to L217-20, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting a consumer mediator (médiateur de la consommation).

Under French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation), articles L217-3 to L217-20, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.

I request that you repair or replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge. If you cannot do this within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, I will ask to end the contract and receive a full refund.

######## FR/noticed-before-delivery/repair/no-reply
{"verdict":"seller-must-prove","claimable":true,"used":false,"extended":false,"legalUntil":"2027-03-01","presumptionUntil":"2027-03-01","faultDate":"2026-10-26","rule":"France","replyDeadline":"2026-11-09","followupDeadline":"2026-11-02","summary":{"country":"FR","category":"phone","condition":"new","remedy":"repair","seller_response":"no-reply","verdict":"seller-must-prove"}}
-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2025 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 December 2024 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation), articles L217-3 to L217-20, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within 2 years of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting a consumer mediator (médiateur de la consommation).

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

26 October 2026

Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Because the fault became apparent within 2 years of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to a consumer mediator (médiateur de la consommation) and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). It has the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation), articles L217-3 to L217-20, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within 2 years of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting a consumer mediator (médiateur de la consommation).

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 March 2026. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation), articles L217-3 to L217-20, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within 2 years of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to a consumer mediator (médiateur de la consommation) and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Under French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation), articles L217-3 to L217-20, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. ######## FR/unknown-category
{"verdict":"seller-must-prove","claimable":true,"used":false,"extended":false,"legalUntil":"2028-03-01","presumptionUntil":"2028-03-01","faultDate":"2026-10-01","rule":"France","replyDeadline":"2026-11-09","followupDeadline":"2026-11-02","summary":{"country":"FR","category":"drone","condition":"new","remedy":"repair","seller_response":"not-contacted","verdict":"seller-must-prove"}}
-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: [Product] (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the [Product] from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation), articles L217-3 to L217-20, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within 2 years of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you repair the [Product] free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting a consumer mediator (médiateur de la consommation).

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, [Product] (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the [Product], delivered on 1 March 2026. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation), articles L217-3 to L217-20, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within 2 years of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair the [Product] free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to a consumer mediator (médiateur de la consommation) and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under Dutch Civil Code (BW), Book 7, articles 7:17 to 7:24, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for goods that do not last as long as can reasonably be expected for a product of this type and price. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting De Geschillencommissie.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 March 2026. Since then, you have refused to resolve the problem.

Under Dutch Civil Code (BW), Book 7, articles 7:17 to 7:24, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for goods that do not last as long as can reasonably be expected for a product of this type and price. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to De Geschillencommissie and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

{"verdict":"lifespan","claimable":true,"used":false,"extended":false,"legalUntil":"","presumptionUntil":"2024-01-10","faultDate":"2026-10-01","rule":"Netherlands","replyDeadline":"2026-11-09","followupDeadline":"2026-11-02","summary":{"country":"NL","category":"phone","condition":"new","remedy":"refund","seller_response":"refused","verdict":"lifespan"}}
-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 10 January 2023 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under Dutch Civil Code (BW), Book 7, articles 7:17 to 7:24, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for goods that do not last as long as can reasonably be expected for a product of this type and price.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting De Geschillencommissie.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

{"verdict":"lifespan","claimable":true,"used":false,"extended":true,"legalUntil":"","presumptionUntil":"2025-06-01","faultDate":"2026-10-01","rule":"Netherlands","replyDeadline":"2026-11-09","followupDeadline":"2026-11-02","summary":{"country":"NL","category":"phone","condition":"new","remedy":"replace","seller_response":"not-contacted","verdict":"lifespan"}}
-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 June 2024 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under Dutch Civil Code (BW), Book 7, articles 7:17 to 7:24, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for goods that do not last as long as can reasonably be expected for a product of this type and price. The goods were repaired under the legal guarantee on 15 August 2026, which extends your liability by 12 months under Directive (EU) 2024/1799.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting De Geschillencommissie.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 June 2024. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under Dutch Civil Code (BW), Book 7, articles 7:17 to 7:24, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for goods that do not last as long as can reasonably be expected for a product of this type and price. The goods were repaired under the legal guarantee on 15 August 2026, which extends your liability by 12 months under Directive (EU) 2024/1799.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to De Geschillencommissie and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 January 2027 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under Dutch Civil Code (BW), Book 7, articles 7:17 to 7:24, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for goods that do not last as long as can reasonably be expected for a product of this type and price.

Because you have not repaired or replaced the goods within a reasonable time, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting De Geschillencommissie.

-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). It has the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under Dutch Civil Code (BW), Book 7, articles 7:17 to 7:24, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for goods that do not last as long as can reasonably be expected for a product of this type and price. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting De Geschillencommissie.

- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 March 2026. Since then, you have refused to resolve the problem.

Under Dutch Civil Code (BW), Book 7, articles 7:17 to 7:24, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for goods that do not last as long as can reasonably be expected for a product of this type and price. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to De Geschillencommissie and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

{"verdict":"seller-must-prove","claimable":true,"used":false,"extended":false,"legalUntil":"","presumptionUntil":"2027-03-01","faultDate":"2026-10-01","rule":"Netherlands","replyDeadline":"2026-11-09","followupDeadline":"2026-11-02","summary":{"country":"NL","category":"drone","condition":"new","remedy":"repair","seller_response":"not-contacted","verdict":"seller-must-prove"}}
-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: [Product] (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the [Product] from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under Dutch Civil Code (BW), Book 7, articles 7:17 to 7:24, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for goods that do not last as long as can reasonably be expected for a product of this type and price. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you repair the [Product] free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting De Geschillencommissie.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, [Product] (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the [Product], delivered on 1 March 2026. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under Dutch Civil Code (BW), Book 7, articles 7:17 to 7:24, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for goods that do not last as long as can reasonably be expected for a product of this type and price. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair the [Product] free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to De Geschillencommissie and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2026 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under Royal Legislative Decree 1/2007 (TRLGDCU), articles 114 to 124, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 3 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within 2 years of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting your local consumer office (OMIC) or the Consumer Arbitration Board.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

Because the fault became apparent within 2 years of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 June 2024 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under Royal Legislative Decree 1/2007 (TRLGDCU), articles 114 to 124, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 3 years of delivery. The goods were repaired under the legal guarantee on 15 August 2026, which extends your liability by 12 months under Directive (EU) 2024/1799.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting your local consumer office (OMIC) or the Consumer Arbitration Board.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2025 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 December 2024 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under Royal Legislative Decree 1/2007 (TRLGDCU), articles 114 to 124, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 3 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within 2 years of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting your local consumer office (OMIC) or the Consumer Arbitration Board.

Under Royal Legislative Decree 1/2007 (TRLGDCU), articles 114 to 124, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 3 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within 2 years of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair the [Product] free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to your local consumer office (OMIC) or the Consumer Arbitration Board and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 June 2024. Since then, you have refused to resolve the problem.

Under Consumer Rights Act 2022, Part 3, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 6 years of delivery.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (CCPC) and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the laptop or computer, delivered on 1 March 2026. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under Consumer Rights Act 2022, Part 3, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 6 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair the laptop or computer free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (CCPC) and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)

Kind regards,
[Your name]

######## OTHER/empty-other-category
{"verdict":"seller-must-prove","claimable":true,"used":false,"extended":false,"legalUntil":"2028-03-01","presumptionUntil":"2027-03-01","faultDate":"2026-10-01","rule":"Other EU country","replyDeadline":"2026-11-09","followupDeadline":"2026-11-02","summary":{"country":"OTHER","category":"other","condition":"new","remedy":"repair","seller_response":"not-contacted","verdict":"seller-must-prove"}}
-------- letter: first
[Your name]
26 October 2026

To: [Seller name]
Subject: Lack of conformity: [Product]

Dear Sir or Madam,

On 1 March 2026 I received the [Product] from you. On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under Directive (EU) 2019/771 on the sale of goods, as implemented in national law, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you repair the [Product] free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the European Consumer Centre (ECC-Net) in your country.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
[Your name]
-------- letter: followup
[Your name]
26 October 2026

To: [Seller name]
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, [Product]

Dear Sir or Madam,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the [Product], delivered on 1 March 2026. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under Directive (EU) 2019/771 on the sale of goods, as implemented in national law, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair the [Product] free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the European Consumer Centre (ECC-Net) in your country and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
[Your name]

-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 January 2027 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under Directive (EU) 2019/771 on the sale of goods, as implemented in national law, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the European Consumer Centre (ECC-Net) in your country.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 January 2027. Since then, you have refused to resolve the problem.

Under Directive (EU) 2019/771 on the sale of goods, as implemented in national law, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the European Consumer Centre (ECC-Net) in your country and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

-------- letter: first
[Your name]
26 October 2026

To: [Seller name]
Subject: Lack of conformity: [Product]

Dear Sir or Madam,

On 1 March 2026 I received the [Product] from you. On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under Directive (EU) 2019/771 on the sale of goods, as implemented in national law, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.

I request that you repair the [Product] free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the European Consumer Centre (ECC-Net) in your country.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
[Your name]
-------- letter: followup
[Your name]
26 October 2026

To: [Seller name]
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, [Product]

Dear Sir or Madam,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the [Product], delivered on 1 March 2026. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under Directive (EU) 2019/771 on the sale of goods, as implemented in national law, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. Because the fault became apparent within one year of delivery, it is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery unless you can prove otherwise.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair the [Product] free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the European Consumer Centre (ECC-Net) in your country and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
[Your name]

-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2025 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 March 2025. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you repair the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 March 2025. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

I request that you replace the Pixel 9 Pro free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to me, as the law requires.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

######## grid/refund/no-reply/price
{"verdict":"covered","claimable":true,"used":false,"extended":false,"legalUntil":"2027-03-01","presumptionUntil":"2026-03-01","faultDate":"2026-10-01","rule":"Germany","replyDeadline":"2026-11-09","followupDeadline":"2026-11-02","summary":{"country":"DE","category":"phone","condition":"new","remedy":"refund","seller_response":"no-reply","verdict":"covered"}}
-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2025 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.

Because you have not repaired or replaced the goods within a reasonable time, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe
-------- letter: followup
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Final notice: lack of conformity, Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 March 2025. Since then, I have not received a reply.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

Because you have not repaired or replaced the goods within a reasonable time, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On [date of first letter] I wrote to you about a fault in the Pixel 9 Pro, delivered on 1 March 2025. Since then, you have refused to resolve the problem.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund of €899. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.

Attached:
- Copy of my letter of [date of first letter]
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

-------- letter: first
Jane Doe
26 October 2026

To: Acme Electronics GmbH
Subject: Lack of conformity: Pixel 9 Pro (order A-1042)

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

On 1 March 2025 I received the Pixel 9 Pro from you (order A-1042). On 1 October 2026 I noticed the following fault: The screen flickers and goes black after a few minutes.

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

Please confirm in writing by 9 November 2026 how you will resolve this. If I do not hear from you by then, I will take further steps, including contacting the Verbraucherzentrale.

Attached:
- Proof of purchase (receipt or invoice)
- Photos or video of the fault

Kind regards,
Jane Doe

Dear Acme Electronics GmbH,

Under German Civil Code (BGB), §§ 434, 437, 439 and 477, which implements Directive (EU) 2019/771, you as the seller are responsible for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery.
A referral to the manufacturer does not replace your own legal obligation as the seller.

Because you have refused to bring the goods into conformity, I am entitled to end the contract. I request a full refund. I will return the Pixel 9 Pro at your expense once you confirm.

This is my final request. If the matter is not resolved by 2 November 2026, I will refer it to the Verbraucherzentrale and consider a claim through the courts, including the European Small Claims Procedure where it applies.
